title: Been stuck in Mall World for a week
content: I'm just... sick of it. The dreams are different every night, and while I'm fully aware and somewhat able to control what I do, I can't escape. I've tried having podcasts on, different genres of music, but I'm still stuck in MallWorld. It's kind of upsetting for me, as MallWorld dreams are never good. They're typically anxiety inducing, as I was a teen when malls had frequent fights, or were incredibly crowded. There were also rumors for a decade that my mall was going to sink into the ground (bad foundational earth), so every MallWorld dream has an underlying anxiety of the mall collapsing while I'm in there, or some fight starting and causing some mob trying to flee the fight Last night was slightly different, in that I managed to find people also looking to escape the mall, but once we got outside, I woke up immediately. I usually don't have others with me in my dreams of MallWorld, as these days I make quick solo trips to just get things done. I don't know if this is a detail that is common, but each visit to MallWorld, the mall is bigger. Sometimes its established on sight that its bigger than last time, but other times hallways will grow as I walk down them to keep me from escaping. Just venting I guess, as nights in MallWorld prevent me from getting restorative sleep, and it's been a full week of increasing exhaustion.
